This program is a modified version of P4wnP1 A.L.O.A.

    commit a56bb4d (2023-10-26) "Support OpenStick LTE modem"

  MaMe82's original project:
    https://github.com/mame82/P4wnP1_aloa

Modifications
-------------
  Copyright (C) 2026 Son-of-David

  This tree is branded R4d-P4wn and targets Radxa Zero 3E (RK3566, arm64)
  in addition to the original Raspberry Pi Zero W platform.

  A file-by-file list of additions and edits versus the upstream commit
  above is in MODIFICATIONS.md.
